content.name: Rebecca Nguyen-Harris
content.title: Head Teacher English
content.summary: Secondary English teacher with 17 years in Sydney schools and certification as a Highly Accomplished Teacher, leading a faculty of 13. My HSC Advanced English classes have averaged above the state mean for eight years, and our faculty lifted Band 5–6 results by 11 percentage points since I became Head Teacher.

experience.title: English Teacher
bullets: Taught English to Years 7–12 across 6 classes, including a Year 11 Standard class and a Year 9 extension group.
Co-ordinated the school's public speaking and debating program, taking a team to the regional final in 2012.
Gained accreditation at Professional Competence with the NSW Institute of Teachers (now NESA) in 2010.

experience.title: English Teacher and Year Adviser
bullets: Taught HSC Advanced and Extension 1 English, with Advanced class averages above the state mean each year.
Served as Year Adviser for a cohort of 190 students from Year 7 to Year 11, coordinating wellbeing support with the learning and support team.
Marked HSC English papers for NESA for four years, bringing standards back into faculty assessment design.
Rewrote the Year 10 assessment schedule to align with the new HSC syllabus, reducing assessment clashes for students by a third.

experience.title: Relieving Head Teacher English
bullets: Led a faculty of 11 during the Head Teacher's leave, managing timetabling, budgets and NESA compliance.
Moved faculty programs and assessment tasks online in two weeks during the 2020 school closures.
Introduced moderated marking for every Stage 6 task, narrowing marker variation between classes.

experience.title: Head Teacher English
bullets: Lead a faculty of 13 English and EAL/D teachers serving 1,250 students and manage an annual faculty budget of $42,000.
Lifted the proportion of HSC English Advanced results in Bands 5–6 from 49% to 60% over four years.
Built a Years 7–10 explicit writing program using shared exemplars, used by every class in the school.
Supervise 3 early career teachers each year through their accreditation at Proficient Teacher.
Achieved certification as a Highly Accomplished Teacher (HALT) in 2023.
